source: Puschmann, T., & Huang-Sui, M. (2024). A taxonomy for decentralized finance. International Review of Financial Analysis, 92, 103083. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.irfa.2024.103083
notes: Dimensions, characteristics, perspectives and exclusivity (E/N) are taken from Table 4; shares of start-ups from Table 5 (n = 278).
Definitions paraphrase the descriptions in Section 3.1; the article gives no application rules.
Exclusive = true means exactly one characteristic per object (E); false means several characteristics may apply (N).
Price mechanism appears under the organization perspective in Table 4.
Shares of non-exclusive dimensions need not sum to 1.

dimensions.name: Blockchain
dimensions.definition: The blockchain around which a specific DeFi solution is centred (the article considers the top blockchains by total value locked).

characteristics.name: Ethereum
characteristics.definition: The DeFi solution is centred on Ethereum.

characteristics.name: Terra
characteristics.definition: The DeFi solution is centred on Terra.

characteristics.name: BSC
characteristics.definition: The DeFi solution is centred on BNB Smart Chain (BSC).

characteristics.name: Avalanche
characteristics.definition: The DeFi solution is centred on Avalanche.

characteristics.name: Solana
characteristics.definition: The DeFi solution is centred on Solana.

characteristics.name: Tron
characteristics.definition: The DeFi solution is centred on Tron.

characteristics.name: Fantom
characteristics.definition: The DeFi solution is centred on Fantom.

characteristics.name: Cronos
characteristics.definition: The DeFi solution is centred on Cronos.

characteristics.name: Cardano
characteristics.definition: The DeFi solution is centred on Cardano.

characteristics.name: Others
characteristics.definition: The DeFi solution is centred on another blockchain.

dimensions.name: Value proposition
dimensions.definition: The different ways of benefits that DeFi solutions can provide.

characteristics.name: Decentralized data infrastructure
characteristics.definition: Storing a record of transaction data on a blockchain instead of a centralized platform.

characteristics.name: Membership management
characteristics.definition: Blockchain-based forms of identification, authentication and data privacy, which allow applications to be designed peer-to-peer without losing the benefits of data privacy and security.

characteristics.name: Analytics & automation
characteristics.definition: Automation of processes through smart contracts, e.g., automated processing of ownership changes of digital assets, which speeds up processes and reduces counterparty risk.

characteristics.name: Crypto-economic model
characteristics.definition: Incentivization of the validators of transactions, rewarding staking for consensus mechanisms such as proof-of-work or proof-of-stake.

characteristics.name: Decentralized governance
characteristics.definition: Decision making performed through decentralized, distributed governance, relying on community voting and participation.

characteristics.name: Aggregation
characteristics.definition: Connection of several DeFi applications to perform complex processes among various DeFi blockchains.

dimensions.name: Token type
dimensions.definition: The type of token used in a specific DeFi scenario.

characteristics.name: Fungible tokens
characteristics.definition: Tokens that are interchangeable with one another.

characteristics.name: Non-fungible tokens
characteristics.definition: Non-exchangeable digital assets whose ownership is authenticated and stored on a blockchain.

dimensions.name: Business process
dimensions.definition: The business process which a DeFi solution attempts to address.

characteristics.name: Payments
characteristics.definition: Payment services, e.g., stablecoins that stabilize the volatility of crypto assets.

characteristics.name: Financing
characteristics.definition: Issuance of loans, e.g., over-collateralized loans secured with crypto assets.

characteristics.name: Investments
characteristics.definition: Investment services, e.g., automated asset management, portfolio management, yield aggregators, crypto asset indices, option marketplaces, perpetual contracts or synthetic assets.

characteristics.name: Insurance
characteristics.definition: Insurance against events such as hacks, attacks on DeFi protocols, smart contract failures or stablecoin price crashes, with compensation from a decentralized pool of coverage providers.

characteristics.name: Trading
characteristics.definition: Trading services, e.g., exchanges, automated market makers and market predictors.

dimensions.name: Price mechanism
dimensions.definition: The price discovery mechanism: the process by which a DeFi solution matches counterparties with regard to their willingness to sell or purchase a given asset for a certain price within a decentralized network.

characteristics.name: Automated
characteristics.definition: Transactions are executed automatically by smart contracts once the pre-programmed contract terms are fulfilled.

characteristics.name: P2P negotiation
characteristics.definition: A potential buyer and seller negotiate the price and other price-related transaction conditions.

characteristics.name: Proposed by maker
characteristics.definition: The transaction initiator proposes a price range on which the counterparty can bid.

characteristics.name: Off-chain order books
characteristics.definition: Order books hosted and updated by centralized third parties (relayers); the blockchain is used only as a settlement layer.

characteristics.name: On-chain order books
characteristics.definition: Every order is stored within a smart contract for deal-matching.

dimensions.name: Protocol type
dimensions.definition: How a specific transaction process is programmed for execution by a DeFi application.

characteristics.name: Reserve aggregation
characteristics.definition: Protocols with centralized control mechanisms, such as maximum prices or a minimum number of liquidity providers.

characteristics.name: Constant function market maker
characteristics.definition: A liquidity pool holding at least two crypto assets in reserve that allows anyone to deposit tokens of one type and thereby withdraw tokens of the other type.

characteristics.name: Peer-to-peer
characteristics.definition: Over-the-counter protocol: participants query the network for counterparties for a given pair of crypto assets and then negotiate the exchange rate bilaterally.

characteristics.name: Decentralized order book exchanges
characteristics.definition: All buy and sell orders are collected in an order book, where potential transactions are matched before being executed.

dimensions.name: Integration type
dimensions.definition: Whether a DeFi solution is implemented on a single chain or across several blockchains, and whether it integrates off-chain data (non-exclusive: the article combines both distinctions in one dimension).

characteristics.name: Single-chain
characteristics.definition: The DeFi solution is implemented on a single blockchain.

characteristics.name: Cross-chain
characteristics.definition: The DeFi solution is implemented across several blockchains.

characteristics.name: On-chain
characteristics.definition: The DeFi solution facilitates on-chain transactions.

characteristics.name: Off-chain
characteristics.definition: The DeFi solution integrates off-chain data on a blockchain through oracles.
